name: Commander Dhamaka
description: a small round Pixar-style 3D alien commander with smooth glossy orange-red skin like a polished toy, a big pear-shaped head with a glowing ruby-red gem in the centre of the forehead, two large glossy black eyes under thick dark angry eyebrows, two long curly whisker-feelers curling upward like a filmi villain's moustache, a black cape with a gold border, short stubby arms and legs
voice: booming theatrical filmi-villain baritone, Hindi, that cracks into a flustered squeak when he is embarrassed
signature: spreads both arms wide and shouts 'Ab hoga DHAMAKA!', then nothing happens
props: a chunky silver ray gun (per shot, not part of the frozen description)
doNot: no hat or helmet (except the mind-control helmet-cannon in E08)
no English dialogue beyond 'Good Morning' and 'delete'
never insults Chintu or Bhondu with level-2 words
notes: Gem colour is the status bar: red = angry and powerful, pink = happy and weak, blue-white = calm and truly powerful (E14 only). Describe the gem colour in every prompt. Redesigned 2026-11-07 at the user's request: the first version (portrait-v1-pumpkin.png) read as a pumpkin-man, so the body now follows the Commander Zog alien shape (smooth, round, pear-shaped head) while keeping Dhamaka's own marks: ruby gem, curly whisker-feelers, black-and-gold cape, orange-red skin.
